newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's RFM to go into food franchising.
newsitem.headline: Manila's RFM to go into food franchising.

text.p: Food and beverage firm RFM Corp said on Tuesday it will diversify into retail food franchising to take advantage of the rapidly-growing sector.
In a statement, RFM president Jose Concepcion said a wholly-owned subsidiary, Asia Food Franchising Corp, had been formed to serve as the vehicle for developing the food franchise business.
In this way, RFM officials said, the company can build and multiply outlets without heavy capital investments every year.
But Asia Food's restaurant concepts will not compete directly against the fast food chain giants such as local firm Jollibee Food Corp or McDonalds, Concepcion said.
Initially, Asia Food will have the Dairy Queen ice cream station, Orange Julius juice and hot dog sandwiches, and Rolling Pin bakeshop franchises, the statement said.
